note: The conclusions (Cauchy coordinates at level m, Cauchy coins and singleton functions via `hail`) are the same; [L] gets them by passing Cauchy-ness from the reference level down the exact recursion (`spends`, `winds`), without the h-m limit or explicitly solving the fixed-dimensional linear systems.

lemma spends {p':∀ m:ℕ,ℕ →F.Coeff}(ht:CauchySeq (p' k))(he:∀ i:ℕ,∀ h:k ≤ i ,∀ᶠ n in atTop,p' i n=(T i h n|>.leanings (W (i+1) n)) (p' (i+1) n))(v:ℕ)(hv:k≤v): CauchySeq (p' v):=by
     induction v,hv using Nat.le_induction with
     | base=>exact ht
     | succ v h ih=>
       apply succor (Ritzy.invests (Q.tight v h) (Q.voyages (v+1) (by omega))) (zero_lt_one.trans_le (Q.tight v h).senior) (fun i x=> (T v h i).hail (W (v+1) i) _) ih (he v h) -- Iiff orientation

proof_context.conclusion: `spends` propagates `CauchySeq` of the level-`k` coordinates down through the recursion to every level `v >= k` by induction.

lemma winds (m:ℕ) (h:r≤ m): CauchySeq (fun n=> y' m n) :=by
     have h' (i:ℕ)(h:r ≤ i): ∀ᶠ n in atTop,y' i n=(T' i h n|>.leanings (W (i+1) n)) (y' (i+1) n):=(L'.sails.eventually (eventually_gt_atTop i)).mono fun n hn=> ((B' n).tallies hG b hz hc hR ht (V n) (hV n) i h hn).2 _
     apply (Matric.Gear.spends (cheerful hG b hz hc hR ht B' L' hZ V hV) _ h' m h)
     have hh:Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ=> y) atTop (𝓝 y):= tendsto_const_nhds
     apply Tendsto.cauchySeq (x:=y) (hh.congr' ?_); filter_upwards [L'.sails.eventually (eventually_ge_atTop r)] with n hn; exact ((he n hn).reads _ |>.trans ((V n).terminal.apply_symm_apply _))|>.symm

proof_context.conclusion: `winds` shows the coefficients at each level `m >= r` form a Cauchy sequence in `n`, using `Gear.spends`.

lemma stays (m:ℕ)(hm:r≤ m): let z n:= (V n).entries m ((V n).terminal.symm y)
     CauchySeq (fun n=> (z n).x) ∧ ∃ T:ℕ→ Coin ((Labels.frames G).level d) (hol G) (D m),CauchySeq T ∧ ∀ n:ℕ,∀ h:m≤ f n,Coin.uses (T n)=capture (z n) (Keeper.sufficient ((B' n).slots m (hR.trans hm) h)):=by
    intro z; let T n:= (W m n).g (y' m n)
    have he:= winds hG b hz hc hR ht B' L' hZ V hV he y m hm; exact ⟨he,T,(cheerful hG b hz hc hR ht B' L' hZ V hV).hides m hm _ he, fun n h=> (B' n).capitals b hc hR ht (V n) (hV n) m hm h _⟩

proof_context.conclusion: `stays` adds that the coefficients and the `Coin` data (which determine the graph) are Cauchy.

snippet.text: lemma hail (m:ℕ)(hr:ψ d≤ m) (t:Motion)(x:∀ i,Site (A.B.a.S.side i p)): Confluence (fun n=> (show Config G (A.B.a.S.side m p)→ℂ from indexX (Lx! n) d (f n) p y x t m)) ∧ ∀ i:Box (A.B.a.S.side m p),Confluence (fun n=> (show Config G (A.B.a.S.side m p)→ℂ from Ktone (Lx! n) d (f n) p y x t m i)):=by
